query: UPDATE user_settings SET push_social = COALESCE(?, push_social), push_battles = COALESCE(?, push_battles), push_competition = COALESCE(?, push_competition), push_challenges = COALESCE(?, push_challenges), push_badges = COALESCE(?, push_badges), push_gym = COALESCE(?, push_gym), quiet_hours_start = IF(?, ?, quiet_hours_start), quiet_hours_end = IF(?, ?, quiet_hours_end) WHERE user_id = ?
